I've answered Tobias in a thread reply in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from this channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 3 Sep 2025 Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with unlabelled totes stacked beside door 4 at Southgate dispatch. At 18:43 that day she said Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident.

None of the channels or public files Tobias can see give an address or site code for Southgate, and there are no Tansley account files in the share. If the customer needs more than the name, I suggested he ask Priyanka or Hollis.
